description:
Wire the binary and the Anthropic client into an end-to-end exchange.

=== What to build ===
'lernie prompt <repo-path> <user-message>':
1. Load <repo-path>/.agent/providers.yaml and <repo-path>/.agent/agents.yaml via the schemas from bl-5bbc.
2. Resolve the 'worker' agent role → (provider, model_id, system_prompt_path).
3. Read the worker system prompt from <repo-path>/.agent/system/prompts/.
4. Send one non-streaming message request via the Anthropic client (bl-9600).
5. Write the exchange to disk. Proposed shape (pick and document in the commit):
     exchanges/<ts>-<short-id>.json
   fields: user_message, assistant_response, model_id, provider, usage, stop_reason, started_at, ended_at.
6. Commit to <repo-path>'s main branch directly. v0.1 explicitly bypasses the branch invariant (ARCH §2.3); flag this in the commit with a reference to ARCH §12.
7. Print the new commit SHA to stdout.

=== Out of scope ===
- Exchange branches, merges, compaction (v0.2).
- Tool calls in the response (v0.3).
- Concurrent exchanges (v0.2+).
- Event log / UI surface (v0.5).

=== Testing ===
- Integration test that chains: 'lernie new' → mock the Anthropic endpoint → 'lernie prompt' → assert the commit exists and its tree contains the expected exchanges/*.json with the mocked response text.

Depends on bl-2904 and bl-9600.
title: lernie binary: 'prompt' subcommand — commit the exchange
